description: Check if a domain name is available for registration — fast DNS check or thorough DNS+WHOIS verification (WhoisXML)

domain.description: Domain name to check availability for (e.g. "example.com", "mybrand.io")

mode.description: Check mode: DNS_ONLY is fast, DNS_AND_WHOIS is more accurate (default DNS_AND_WHOIS)

name: whois.domain.availability

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Check Domain Availability
